Mei Chen: Quick alert 3 Orpheus-v2 int8 landed on staging (build 20260401.7) and small locale smoke shows two consistent regressions: 1) CJK date tokens lose interstitial spaces (e.g. '2024 年' -> '2024年') and 2) ASCII parentheses are mirrored inside Arabic/RTL lines. Repro below.
Sara V: Ugh. Can you paste exact input + outputs from the call?
Mei Chen: Pasted from staging endpoint (test-run: staging-int8-2026-04-01-7).
Input:
```
請於 2024 年 08 月 15 日 提交 報告 (due: 08/15/2024)
45312c2829 4a482c2f 2744332c44 (15/08/2024)
```
FP16 baseline:
```
請於 2024 年 08 月 15 日 提交 報告 (due: 08/15/2024)
45312c2829 4a482c2f 2744332c44 (15/08/2024)
```
INT8 (orpheus-v2 qkernel v1.2.3, fused-kvfold2):
```
請於2024

08
15日提交報告 )due: 08/15/2024(
45312c2829 4a482c2f 2744332c44 )15/08/2024(
```
Notes: In the Chinese line you can see the spaces around the unit tokens (年/月/日) are collapsed; in the Arabic line the ASCII parentheses appear reversed relative to baseline.
Jordan P: Two hypotheses: (A) tokenization boundary changed (token ids differ), or (B) quantized logits pushed argmax to different token during generation. Did we change tokenizer/vocab?
Mei Chen: Tokenizer package unchanged (tokenizer==1.14 pinned). I ran token diffs with `ci/token_diff.py --left fp16 --right int8 --sample 999` and found merges like `['2024', ' ', '\u5e74'] -> ['2024\u5e74']` for INT8. Also a couple bidi-sensitive punctuation tokens shifted id.
Kevin L: We flipped quant scheme to per-layer asymmetric int8 and enabled fused-kvfold2 for perf in qkernel v1.2.3. That combination can subtly alter logits near token boundaries. We also changed rounding mode to "nearest_even" in this build.
Sara V: Can you run with `return_tokens=true` to confirm token ids changed? Also try greedy decoding (beam=1) to remove sampling noise.
Mei Chen: Done. With `return_tokens` the int8 path emits a single token for '2024\u5e74' while fp16 emits the three-token sequence. The difference persists under greedy.
Anna S: If logits shifting is the culprit, we should run a targeted perturbation test: craft inputs where two tokens have nearly-equal logits (e.g. '2024' + [space] + '年') and assert parity. We should also add a small locale prompt set to the regression CI.
Jordan P: Agreed. I'll add deterministic unit tests that force logits at threshold and check tokenization/detokenization parity for patterns: ["2024 \u5e74", "(15/08/2024)", "10 \u6708"] and bidi bracket cases.
Kevin L: Quick plan: 1) roll back fused-kvfold2 in a patch build (cheap), 2) experiment with symmetric per-channel quant and keep nearest_even rounding off. Spawning job 10021 now. Expect small perf hit but should indicate root cause.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-orpheus-v2-int8-patch (build: 20260401.7.patch1) started 3 6 instances.
Sara V: Also run fast locale harness across zh, ja, ar, he and capture token-delta counts + BLEU/chrF. Block promote if zh chrF drop > 0.4 or ar BLEU drop > 1.2.
Mei Chen: Kicked off quick sweep: `./tools/locale_smoke --run staging-orpheus-int8-patch --langs zh,ja,ar,he --out s3://redwood-smoke/orpheus-int8-patch-quick.json`. ETA ~18m. Will paste results.
Jordan P: If patch fixes it, add regression tests and consider a guarded perf flip for fused-kvfold2 behind an opt-in flag until we can verify numeric stability.
Anna S: I'll open a PR to add the date/bracket prompts to locale-regressions and gate them on int8 smoke runs.
Kevin L: Patch build queued and running. Will report back with perf and smoke output.
Mei Chen: Thanks all 1 mag: if anyone spots more bidi/quote anomalies, drop examples here.
Sara V: Assigning actions: Kevin = kernel revert + perf report, Jordan = unit tests, Anna = PR for regression prompts.
Kevin L: On it.
Mei Chen: I'll post the smoke artifacts once complete.
